/padi.lighting:1.body: {"Header":{"Name":"padi.lighting","Owner":"Padi, Inc.","Title":"Lighting Control","Provider":"Controller","Consumer":"Luminaire","Description":"Connects a lighting controller to a controllable luminaire. The Provider supplies the desired level and optionally color and fade time; the Consumer acts on them and reports the level achieved and, on request, its power draw. Succeeds the 2022-era cp:padi.light contract, which remains published under its own name: levels are continuous rather than binary, properties are purpose-named, and device identification is left to the Realm's Context rather than carried as label properties.","Website":"https://padi.io/lighting","Status":"Deprecated"},"Properties":{"Provider":[{"Name":"level","Mandatory":"yes","Propagate":"yes","Default":"0","Description":"The desired light level as a fraction, 0 to 1; 0 is off, 1 is fully on.","Sample":"0.75"},{"Name":"color","Mandatory":"no","Propagate":"yes","Description":"The desired color, as a CSS hex color. A luminaire that cannot render color ignores it.","Sample":"#FFD9A0"},{"Name":"fade","Mandatory":"no","Propagate":"yes","Default":"0","Description":"Seconds over which the luminaire should move to a newly delivered level; 0 means immediately.","Sample":"1.5"}],"Consumer":[{"Name":"actual","Mandatory":"yes","Propagate":"yes","Description":"The light level actually achieved, as a fraction, 0 to 1. Carries no Default, deliberately: the level achieved has no value until the luminaire reports one.","Sample":"0.75"},{"Name":"power","Mandatory":"no","Propagate":"no","Description":"Present power draw in watts, supplied to the single Connection that asked.","Sample":"8.5"}]}}
